name: Jodhpur
scopeLimits: The ranked UN World Urbanization Prospects 2025 population-weighted locator is not a municipal boundary or parcel identity. Official local/state property or cadastral services were identified, but no point-specific public parcel polygon was verified. No full geometry is retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: A first-party Jodhpur Development Authority meeting document explicitly discusses numbered cadastral/revenue parcels in revenue village Jodhpur, with local authority land-record review. The Government of India DILRMP result names Jodhpur district in its map-digitization status. These confirm local land-record activity; the state Urban GIS shell alone does not establish Jodhpur point coverage or public parcel vectors.
technicalBlocker: The official Urban GIS HTML is visible through web access, but shell HTTPS to its host timed out; no JS/service endpoint or successful Jodhpur city selection could be examined. BhuNaksha does not establish coverage without selected village/extent.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the specific WUP locator is covered by a Jodhpur urban Khasra layer or the state revenue BhuNaksha; whether either portal offers anonymous machine-readable vector geometry.
